purpose: Rat MIRI (myocardial ischaemia-reperfusion) disease input for the Stage 1 MIRI reference DEG list

sources.method: GEO acquisition (Agilent SurePrint G3 GE 8x60K FEATURES files) followed by the limma WT IR vs WT Sham DEG analysis; source/GSE108940_WT_deg_results.csv is the limma output written by script/build_deg.R (the raw Agilent inputs are not redistributed)

local_additions.origin: per-GSE MIRI reference DEG list (rat-to-human ortholog mapped to the L1000 978 landmark genes); tracked before the restructure
full rat-to-human L1000 DEG table (human_gene, direction, logFC, P.Value); regenerable, never tracked (global *.csv rule)

note: manifest, verified_at, verify_result and tree_sha256 are filled by ticket 09
notes: RAT ORIGIN: GSE108940 is a rat (Rattus norvegicus) MIRI series, not a human cohort. The gene set consumed by the workflow is derived by rat-to-human ortholog mapping (homologene via org.Rn.eg.db Entrez IDs in script/map_to_human.R:rat2human), then filtered to the human L1000 978 landmarks; the rat symbol is kept only in the JSON description, the DEG list itself is human-symbol. Split from the old shared `miri/` level under `disease_data/` in ticket 05 (spec §4): source/ is the old data/, local/deg/ the old deg/ minus build_deg.R, and both shared R helpers are copied into script/.
